title: Book Three · Chapter 182: The Note and the Mirror
story:
On Monday, Ronan returns to the school office for his final teacher's note.

The teacher has finished it. She gives him the page and lets him check his name and the date.

It describes his completed school work. The page is an update for the coastal centre.

Ronan thanks her. He keeps a copy for himself and puts the signed page in an envelope with a short covering letter.

At the post office, he sends it to the coastal centre. The postage comes from his separate spending money. His saved envelopes stay at home.

When he returns, Mum is with a customer near the window. A jacket lies across the woman's knees.

Mum asks her to try it on. The woman stands and moves both arms.

“Here,” she says, touching one sleeve.

Mum watches the movement and asks her to reach toward the shelf. Then she makes a small mark beside the seam.

Ronan waits near the kitchen door. Mum sees him and asks for the small mirror.

He brings it over and holds it behind the woman's shoulder. She can see the back in Mum's other mirror.

“The collar is right,” she says.

Mum nods and checks the sleeve again. Ronan holds the mirror still. Mum finishes the check and steps back.

After the woman leaves, Mum puts the jacket beside her work book. She has agreed to adjust the sleeve before the woman collects it on Friday.

Ronan puts both mirrors away.

“The class pattern?” he asks.

“Part of it. Each person still needs a different fit.”

She takes the marked sleeve to her chair. Ronan opens his phrase book at the other side of the table.

For a while, they work quietly. He tries a short question aloud. Mum looks up from the cloth.

“A customer?”

“A visitor asking about a room.”

“Then ask about the light.”

He smiles and finds a simple sentence for it. He says it slowly, then once more at an ordinary pace.

Mum listens to the second try and nods. Then she turns the sleeve and begins another line of small stitches.

At lunch, Dad comes in from the workshop. He asks about the school office, and Ronan tells him the update is in the post.

Dad puts his cup beside the bowl. Mum sets her work aside. Ronan clears space for the food, with his new phrase book still open near the window.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

signed＝签好名字的；covering letter＝随材料附上的简短信；adjust＝作小调整；fit＝衣物合身的程度。

## 理解问题

1. 周一实际领取并寄出了什么？这是否新增一份申请或代表录取？
2. Mum怎样听清顾客需要、运用所学？Ronan在旁边做了哪件具体小事？

## 读句子

**Ronan holds the mirror still.**

拆开看：Ronan / holds the mirror still.

Ronan／把镜子稳稳拿着。
